body:
Uses Edgar as leverage while insisting that the company release the captain.

Recorded role and choices

In the July 2025 exchange, Spade checks that the returned captain is genuine, arranges for other hostages to be brought over and then keeps Edgar within the pirates’ group until the captain is freed. His actions establish a specific negotiator and coercive participant. He is not the captain, and neither the playing-card name nor the generic pirate labels establish continuity with other encounters.
